description: Turn Search Console, GA4 or Ahrefs rows (also rows the user pastes) into the fastest wins, instead of judging them by hand; content_decay and traffic_drop take search_type for Discover, News, Image or Video rows. Pick with mode: ctr_gaps = Page 1 results with a click-through rate far below normal. Needs rows[{position, page, query, clicks, impressions, ctr}]. striking_distance = Queries at positions 8 to 20 worth a push. Needs rows[{position, page, query, clicks, impressions, ctr}]. content_decay = Pages slowly losing clicks over months: a refresh queue. Needs rows[{url, month, clicks}]. traffic_drop = Explain a drop page by page, by device and country. Needs rows[{url, before, after, query, device, country}]. prune = Keep, refresh, merge (301), noindex or remove (410) per page. Needs rows[{url, clicks, impressions, conversions, referring_domains, inlinks}]. discover = Readiness for Google Discover and News, with Discover or News rows. paid_organic = Google Ads terms against Search Console: ad spend you can test cutting, content to write. Needs ads[{term, cost, clicks, conversions}], gsc[{query, position, clicks, page}]. anomalies = Spike and drop days in daily rows, with Google updates near them. Needs rows[{date, clicks, impressions, page}]. ai_queries = Question and prompt-style queries per page, for AI answers. Needs rows[{query, page, clicks, impressions, position}].

drop_date.description: Optional first day of the drop, YYYY-MM-DD, to check Google updates around it.

fix_log_id.description: Optional fix log from log_fix, to spot undone fixes on losing pages.

rows.description: Search Console rows for one period (28 days works well).

search_type.description: Search Console search type of the rows, default web.
